items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: And I remember when she was on the show where we were playing, I told Johnny, he was directing the band, and she had her own pianos there.

ctx.x: And I remember when she was on the show where we were playing, I told Johnny, he was directing the band, and she had her own pianos there. Mm-hmm. And I said, Johnny, keep your tempo. Don't worry about how she's singing, you keep your tempo. So, Johnny went to, she was doing Lover Man, and she slows it down, you know. Mm-hmm. And Johnny went to slow down with her, and she turned around, she said, play the music, goddammit, I'll be at the end with you. Yeah? Yes, I had to let, from that time on I said, now you…
Could she make change? Oh, yes. Oh, yeah. She, she, I mean, in that club. Yeah.
